query: INSERT INTO support_rate_limits(bucket,window_at,requests) VALUES($1,now(),1) ON CONFLICT(bucket) DO UPDATE SET requests=CASE WHEN support_rate_limits.window_at < now()-interval '1 minute' THEN 1 ELSE support_rate_limits.requests+1 END,window_at=CASE WHEN support_rate_limits.window_at < now()-interval '1 minute' THEN now() ELSE support_rate_limits.window_at END RETURNING requests
